pairs.name: page
pairs.reason: Holds the rows below; the Not listed row is a line longer, which moves the bar. When to arrive is never inferred (plan §2.3: not stored, so Not listed); the mock's sample event carries a fixed arrival policy, so its When reads 'Listed times · arrive by the start time' and its Not listed leaves it out, one line shorter. Its rounded corners show the street behind: The app draws the street as pictures (EV2a's agreed budget: 31 SVG nodes against the mock's 3,937), the mock as live SVG; edges and thin strokes (the rain, the clouds' rims) anti-alias a pixel apart.
